titulo: Magic circle: Stonehenge offers lucky visitors 20 minutes alone in monument
cuerpo: Handful of ticketholders will be selected at random for up-close visits to ancient site throughout August Trips to Stonehenge can be a little hectic. Tens of thousands of people turn up to celebrate summer and winter solstices and most other days the site is a place of bustle, excited conversation and selfie action. But throughout August, English Heritage is offering visitors the chance to win some guaranteed solitude within the hulking stones. Continue reading...
